findings.title: Apple Safari/iOS Pointer Authentication Bypass
findings.summary: A vulnerability in Apple's Pointer Authentication allows attackers with arbitrary read/write capabilities to bypass security protections.

findings.title: GitLab RCE (CVE-2026-97229)
findings.summary: An integer overflow in regular expression validation allows unauthenticated remote code execution on GitLab servers.

findings.title: Zyxel GS1900 Stack Buffer Overflow
findings.summary: A stack-based buffer overflow in the CGI program allows unauthenticated LAN attackers to execute OS commands.

findings.title: Android GhostMap Vulnerabilities
findings.summary: Multiple memory safety flaws in Android allow for remote code execution and denial of service without user interaction.

findings.title: Linux Kernel TCP Use-After-Free
findings.summary: A memory corruption vulnerability in the Linux kernel's TCP stack allows for potential privilege escalation.

findings.title: Zyxel GS1900 Out-of-Bounds Write
findings.summary: An out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the CGI program allows unauthenticated adjacent attackers to execute OS commands.

findings.title: Linux Kernel Root Escalation Flaws (OpenAI Research)
findings.summary: Multiple vulnerabilities in the Linux kernel, including use-after-free and memory corruption issues, were identified as part of an AI-driven exploit research project.

findings.title: Debian/Ubuntu APT Hard Link RCE
findings.summary: A vulnerability in APT allows on-path attackers to trick clients into installing unverified packages for root code execution.

findings.title: SonicWall GMS End-of-Life Vulnerabilities
findings.summary: Unpatched flaws in EoL SonicWall GMS versions allow unauthenticated file reading and authenticated SQL injection.
